mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% in the most recent month, it signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the average return in triggered months is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 3-month moving averages indicates a broad-based consumer and housing sector recovery, which signals improving economic conditions and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index, 2017=100), the market anticipates a slowdown in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising employment level (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates improving labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed $700 billion in the most recent month, it signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when RSAFS > 700000, or the average return in triggered months is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 305 indicates a policy response to inflationary pressures, which typically leads to positive equity returns as the market anticipates sustained economic growth over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 5.0 and CPIAUCSL > 305, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high housing starts (HOUST > 1400 thousand units), the housing sector's strength signals a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST > 1400, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
